title: Media Buy Delivery Totals
description: Delivery totals for a media buy, including the effective rate.

allOf.description: Aggregate metrics for this media buy across all packages. When the buy's packages report a metric_id under more than one qualifier set (whether in by_package[].metric_values or in a package's flat carrier), sellers MUST omit that metric's flat carrier (the whole nested object, e.g. viewability, brand_lift) from these totals rather than combine rows; buyers read the package rows. One row is one (scope, metric_id, qualifier) key.

effective_rate.description: Effective rate paid per unit based on pricing_model (e.g., actual CPM for 'cpm', actual cost per completed view for 'cpcv', actual cost per point for 'cpp')
